- **Translucency**: The layering of the net over the pillows and bedding is physically plausible. The occlusion is correct.
- **Support Structure**: The apex of the net connects logically to the ceiling/frame structure. There is no floating or disconnected geometry at the top.

No new artifacts were found. The severity ratings (none) are appropriate.
